text:
alex.g: Heads-up — noticed several README snippets in sdk-js are failing when you copy/paste. Trying to help triage before new hire onboarding tomorrow.
maya: which snippets? can you paste an example?
alex.g: the top of sdk-js/README.md still shows `client.generate(...)` and `Api-Key` header example. our current SDK uses `client.responses.create(...)` and we recommend `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
jamie: oh yikes — that will confuse anyone following the quickstart. do we know when that drift happened?
alex.g: probably when we landed the v2 API changes last quarter. quick diff:

```diff
- const res = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-1', input: 'hi' })
+ const res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-1', input: 'hi' })
```

and headers:

```http
- Api-Key: sk_xxx
+ Authorization: Bearer sk_xxx
```

leo: thanks for catching. I can put up a patch. prefer one PR that updates examples + a short note in the changelog about snippet parity?
alex.g: +1 to single PR. also we should run the docs-snippet linter we added — but I couldn't get it to run locally because `make docs-check` hits `node` v14 constraints on my laptop.
maya: hm the linter is in the devcontainer workflow. maybe we should add an npm script that runs only snippet-check so devs don't need the full container.
jamie: can you open the PR, leo? include before/after examples and mention that the JS sample was failing copy/paste for auth and method names. tag me for review.
leo: will do. quick checklist I'll follow in the PR description:
- update sdk-js/README.md code blocks (js, ts)
- run docs-snippet-check and include output
- update a small paragraph in quickstart about auth header style
- add a test snippet in playground that executes the example (if possible)
alex.g: one more thing — some examples show `client.init({ apiKey: process.env.API_KEY })` which doesn't exist anymore. replace with `new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` to match env var naming.
doc-bot: Reminder: docs maintainers — please include the `docs` label on the PR and link to the guide: https://redwood.dev/docs/contrib#snippets
maya: small follow-up: can we add a note in onboarding checklist to run `npm run snippet-check` (or `make docs-check`) to catch these before a new hire follows the README?
leo: yep adding that to the PR description and will open a small follow-up ticket to add `npm run snippet-check` that runs the snippet linter only.
jamie: thanks all — massive onboarding friction saver. :party_parrot:
alex.g: thanks! I'll smoke-test the updated README once the PR lands.
